name: runtime-seed-dsh
description: npm prod install of @deepseek-ai/dsh, shipped as resources/runtime-seed-dsh. Pinned EXACTLY (not ^): dsh is a developer preview whose README promises compatibility-breaking changes between rc builds, so the bundled baseline moves only when a human bumps this line and re-runs `npm run seed:dsh`. NOTE 0.1.2-rc.1 ships on the `next` dist-tag while `latest` still points at 0.1.1-rc.2, so features/dsh.js's update check (npm view <pkg> version, i.e. `latest`) sees an OLDER version than the one bundled here and correctly reports 'already up to date' until upstream moves the tag.
